_README: Reviewed factory defaults for dialects without a dedicated parser, read by app.facts.recognizers._absence.
A setting listed here for a dialect is one that dialect does NOT enforce unless its configuration states it,
so when the dialect is understood and no line states it, it is decided NOT_SET (like an AAA server).
Only add an entry with its source; a guess here would turn a missing line into a false FAIL.
Keys are the seed 'vendor' labels; values map a predicate to the reason shown to the user.

Palo Alto PAN-OS.auth.password.min_length: PAN-OS ships with Minimum Password Complexity disabled, so no minimum length is enforced until 'set mgt-config password-complexity' enables it (PAN-OS Administrator's Guide, Device > Setup > Management)
